notes: REF-BM-10: tags input is plain text; no datalist/autocomplete of existing tags. REF-BM-14: no '#' handling in parseQuery; '#' is stripped by FTS tokenizer so #tag becomes an ordinary all-column term, not tag-specific search. REF-BM-15: AND/OR/NOT and quoting-operators-as-literal work, but parentheses are not parsed as groups (linear parser; parens passed as literal chars). REF-BM-20: bulk system works for add/remove tags, archive/unarchive, delete, set-read-later, but cannot bulk mark-as-read (clear read_later), so read/unread is one-way. REF-BM-23: notes stored and editable but never rendered as markdown and not shown when viewing (no markdown dependency, notes absent from card render). REF-BM-24: HTML single-file snapshot with <base> works, but PDF rule not implemented (non-HTML content-type yields empty html and a 502; PDF is not downloaded/stored). REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive/Wayback integration (only a seed bookmark pointing to archive.org). REF-BM-32: no persisted user settings; sort is session-only UI state, and no displayed-items or font-size setting or storage exists.
